_note: Keys MUST match SoundEngine.ASSETS keys in js/audio.js (e.g. `ui`, not `ui_click`; aliases like thunder/splash/cast need their own entries even when they share a file). The audio loader reads this first so it never 404-probes missing formats (mp3/ogg/wav fallback only runs when this file is unreachable, e.g. file://). Regenerate by listing assets/audio/.
